_description: Registry of cutscenes that can be played via CutsceneManager (type=realtime_3d) or PreRenderedCutscenePlayer (type=prerendered). Adding a cutscene should be a data-only operation — pair a new entry here with the actual assets and the cutscene becomes playable. See docs/architecture/CODE_REVIEW.md §6A.6 and docs/architecture/cutscenes/PRERENDERED_PIPELINE.md.

_field_reference.id: Stable identifier used by code (e.g. passed to CutsceneManager.start_cutscene(id) or emitted as cutscene_completed(id, ...)).
_field_reference.type: Playback flavour: 'realtime_3d' (CutsceneManager drives a live 3D scene with camera + dialogue UI) or 'prerendered' (PreRenderedCutscenePlayer plays a PNG sequence + WAV baked in Blender).
_field_reference.scene_path: res:// path to the PackedScene that hosts the cutscene.
_field_reference.dialogue_path: res:// path to the dialogue JSON that drives the CutsceneManager sequences. realtime_3d only.
_field_reference.camera_animation_name: Name of an AnimationPlayer track baked into the .glb/.tscn to drive the camera. realtime_3d only.
_field_reference.camera_path_json: Fallback: res:// path to the JSON camera-keyframe table. realtime_3d only.
_field_reference.frames_dir: prerendered only. res:// path to the directory holding the frame_NNNN.png sequence.
_field_reference.dialogue_wav: prerendered only. res:// path to the dialogue audio WAV, or empty for silent.
_field_reference.fps: prerendered only. Frame rate the sequence was rendered at (default 24).
_field_reference.title: Human-readable label for debug logs, QA screenshots, and the future cutscene picker.
_field_reference.arc: Narrative arc this cutscene belongs to (arc1 .. arc10). Used to scope playback windows and filter in the future cutscene picker.
_field_reference.tags: Optional free-form tags (e.g. recruitment, combat_intro, finale) for future gating.
_field_reference.notes: Optional human notes — shipping status, blockers, art dependencies.

cutscenes.title: No Tail Outpost — crew recruitment
cutscenes.notes: Sprint 7 rewrite target. Runtime interior / burn marks / material-applicator hacks all live in cutscene_scene.gd and should move into the .blend when the Blender-first rework lands (see CODE_REVIEW.md §6A.6). camera_animation_name currently empty — falls back to camera_path.json until the baked AnimationPlayer track ships.

cutscenes.title: Dave — intro line (style-test origin)
cutscenes.notes: First prerendered cutscene — proves the Blender -> ffmpeg -> PNG-sequence pipeline. Two-shot: side-on walk (30 frames) + stylised 3/4 close-up with dialogue card (114 frames looping the idle action). Audio: macOS `say -v Daniel` TTS, swap for real VO when cast. Art direction: painterly toon-shade + Solidify outlines, see docs/architecture/cutscenes/PRERENDERED_PIPELINE.md. Mouth animation deliberately not implemented (see same doc §Known limitations).
